meta.title: Book at {shop}
meta.description: Book your appointment at {shop}. No account, no app: pick a service, a barber and a time.

cerrado.title: Online booking is off right now
cerrado.body: This barbershop isn't taking appointments online. Give them a call and they'll save you a spot.

servicio.title: What are we doing today?
servicio.sub: You can pick more than one.
servicio.vacio: This barbershop hasn't published its services yet.

barbero.title: With whom?
barbero.sub: No preference? Pick the first one and we'll assign whoever is free.
barbero.vacio: This barbershop hasn't published its team yet.

fecha.title: Which day?
fecha.sub: Only days with openings show up.
fecha.sinHoras: That day is full. Try another one.
fecha.sinDias: No openings in the next few weeks.

datos.title: Who's it for?
datos.sub: No passwords: your name and your WhatsApp are enough.
datos.notasPlaceholder: Optional: the usual cut, allergies, etc.
datos.aviso: By booking you agree the barbershop may contact you on WhatsApp to confirm.

confirmacion.subPendiente: The barbershop will confirm on WhatsApp shortly.
confirmacion.cualquierBarbero: We'll assign a barber when you arrive
confirmacion.duplicada: This appointment was already saved with your number.

meta.title: My account at {shop}
meta.description: Your appointments, visits and payments at {shop}.

login.title: Sign in with your WhatsApp
login.sub: No passwords: we'll text you a 6-digit code.
login.codigoSub: We sent it on WhatsApp. It expires in {min} minutes.
login.invalido: That code isn't valid or it expired. Ask for a new one.

citas.title: Upcoming appointments
citas.reagendarEnviado: We let the barbershop know. They'll message you on WhatsApp.
citas.noSePuedeCancelar: For last-minute changes, message the barbershop.

lealtad.title: Your loyalty card
lealtad.falta: {n} to go for your free cut
lealtad.comoFunciona: It applies on your next visit. Remind your barber.

solicitudes.title: Booking requests
solicitudes.sub: What people book from your page. Accept or decline and it becomes an appointment.
solicitudes.vacioPendientes: No pending requests. All caught up.
solicitudes.vacioResueltas: You haven't resolved any requests yet.
solicitudes.sinPermiso: You don't have permission to handle requests.
solicitudes.modoManual: Mode: you approve by hand. Every online booking waits for your OK.
solicitudes.modoAuto: Mode: auto-confirm. Online bookings go straight into the calendar.
